name: Lẩu tả pín lù
summary: A hotpot the clay-pot rice note includes in its snapshot of Da Lat cooking.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note names lẩu tả pín lù at cơm niêu Việt Nam, with artichoke pork hock and braised fish. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The note names the pot and does not say what goes in it.
where: Cơm niêu Việt Nam, 3h Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa, open 09:00–22:00.
priceBand: A price for this pot alone is Check on arrival. The door’s printed band is 30,000–380,000 VND.
